title: Fitzroy Island National Park
get_in: Fitzroy Island is only accessible by ferry from Cairns. Ferries depart at 8AM, 11AM and 1:30PM. The trip takes 45 minutes. A day return trip costs $82. Contact '''Fitzroy Island Resort'''. {{phone|+61 7 4044 6700}}. {{email|stay@fitzroyisland.com}}. You can buy tickets that include some combination of snorkeling equipment hire, a barbecue lunch and a glass bottom boat tour.
